title: Software Engineer 1
description_text:
About the role: Join our payments platform team in Hyderabad (hybrid, 3 days in office).
Requirements: 0-2 years of experience building backend services. Strong Python and SQL. Familiarity with REST APIs, Git, Docker.
Exposure to AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda) is a plus. Nice to have: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
Certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner are a plus.
Ideal candidate: curious, strong problem solver, good communication, eager to learn, ownership mindset. B.Tech/B.E. in CS or related.

title: SDE 2 - Platform
description_text:
We are hiring an SDE 2 for our platform team. You have 3+ years of experience with Java or Python, distributed systems,
microservices, Kafka, and Kubernetes. Must have: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL. Nice to have: Terraform, Go, gRPC.
You will own services end-to-end, mentor juniors, and collaborate across teams. Strong system design skills expected.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description_text:
Forward Deployed Engineer (Remote, India). 2-4 years of experience shipping production software with customers.
Build LLM applications with OpenAI and Anthropic Claude APIs, RAG pipelines, LangChain/LangGraph, vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector).
Strong Python, TypeScript, SQL. Deploy on Azure or GCP. Experience with agents and MCP is a big plus.
Ideal candidate: customer-facing, comfortable with ambiguity, excellent communicator, travels to client sites occasionally.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description_text:
Machine Learning Engineer (Hybrid, Hyderabad). Minimum 2 years of experience in ML. Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, SQL.
Build and deploy models on AWS SageMaker or Amazon Bedrock. MLOps: MLflow, Docker, Airflow. Spark/PySpark and Databricks preferred.
GenAI experience: fine-tuning, RAG, Hugging Face transformers. AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate preferred.
We want someone with strong fundamentals in statistics, a bias for action, and clear written communication.

title: Associate Data Analyst
description_text:
Associate Data Analyst. Freshers or up to 1 year experience. Advanced SQL and Excel, Python (pandas), Power BI or Tableau.
Exposure to Snowflake or BigQuery and dbt is a plus. Google Data Analytics certificate or Microsoft PL-300 a plus.
Ideal candidate: detail-oriented, structured thinker, storytelling with data, stakeholder communication.

title: DevOps Engineer 2
description_text:
DevOps Engineer II. 3-5 years of experience. Must have: AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, VPC), Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions),
Linux, Bash, Python scripting. Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. Nice to have: Azure, Helm, ArgoCD.
Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, CKA, HashiCorp Terraform Associate preferred.
Ideal candidate: automation-first mindset, calm during incidents, documents everything.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description_text:
Senior Software Engineer. 5-8 years of experience. Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, AWS, Kubernetes. Lead design reviews.
Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) is a plus. Ideal candidate: technical leadership as an IC, mentoring, pragmatic.

title: Data Scientist Intern
description_text: Data Science Internship for students. Python, pandas, SQL. 6 months.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description_text: Staff Engineer. 10+ years of experience leading infrastructure. AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, org-wide technical strategy.

title: AWS Cloud Engineer
description_text:
AWS Cloud Engineer. Build and operate our AWS landing zone. Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), CI/CD.
Nice to have: GCP, Snowflake. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate required. Strong ownership and on-call readiness.

title: Software Engineer
description_text: Software Engineer, onsite in Pune. 2+ years of experience with Java and Spring Boot.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description_text: 6-month contract. BI Analyst with 2-4 years of experience in Power BI, SQL, Azure Synapse.

title: GenAI Engineer
description_text:
GenAI Engineer to build retrieval-augmented generation systems and AI agents. Python, LangGraph, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Gemini,
vector databases (Weaviate, Qdrant), evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering. Docker, FastAPI. Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) preferred. Ideal candidate: experimental, rigorous about evals, communicates trade-offs clearly.
